content: Go libp2p pubsub per-peer outbound buffering, read directly from pubsub.go: peerOutboundQueueSize default 32 (option WithPeerOutboundQueueSize), per-peer bounded rpcQueue created via newRpcQueue(size), messages DROPPED when queue full ('We start dropping messages to a peer if the outbound queue is full'), per-peer goroutine handleNewPeer. This drop-not-block policy is the established Go approach to slow-peer memory bounding.
